create_TransfoXLTokenizer: create a TransfoXLTokenizer instance from a pretrained vocabulary file for Transformer-XL models
build_TransfoXLCorpus: build a TransfoXLCorpus from a data directory with supported datasets like ptb, wt103, or lm1b
encode_file_TransfoXLTokenizer: encode a text file into tokenized LongTensor sequences using the TransfoXLTokenizer
get_iterator_TransfoXLCorpus: get a data iterator for train, valid, or test splits from a TransfoXLCorpus with configurable batch size and bptt
run_get_lm_corpus: run get_lm_corpus to load or produce a cached language model corpus for a given dataset and data directory
